originalCaseRow:
| **M9-T-T06 PDF缩放计时释放**
M9-R06.5、M9-R08.7 | 本期本机 | 组件／集成／安装端到端
U+I / D06+D11 | 假时钟模拟连续Ctrl+wheel，推进119/120ms、199/200ms；随后销毁。 | 120ms结束zoom状态、200ms清raw累计；卸载取消timer；下一文档不收到旧回调。
依据：V D04 | P11；已有候选页面；本用例全部状态尚未核验 | 未执行 | — |
stepsUnchanged: 假时钟模拟连续Ctrl+wheel，推进119/120ms、199/200ms；随后销毁。
expectedUnchanged: 120ms结束zoom状态、200ms清raw累计；卸载取消timer；下一文档不收到旧回调。
layerBoundary: Unit tests bind real DOM WheelEvents to the shared production handler. Integration mounts the actual production React FilePdfPreview and prototype FilePdfPreview, dispatches real DOM wheel events and observes zoom/scroll state and real effects/cleanup under fake timers. PDF decode/canvas are isolated; no real PDF parsing/rendering, native IO, Browser or packaged App E2E is claimed. Those are not explicit layers of T06.

facts: Five small deltaY=-1 events remain stuck at100% rather than raw accumulated102.5315%.
After unmount, prior RAF mutates detached scrollLeft50→65.7756377113.

change: Shared App/prototype bindPdfWheel owns each document binding, unsnapped raw scale, both120/200ms timers and one coalesced anchor RAF.
Every nonzero Ctrl+wheel restarts both timers; raw and visible snapped values are distinct. Explicit scale changes use a fresh baseline.
Cleanup removes listener and cancels timers and RAF without invoking callbacks. App buffer/session and prototype path/source changes recreate binding.
Preserves pointer anchor across multiple events before a frame; tracks pending anchor rather than reading stale scroll coordinates.
Uses the reviewed30–800% clamp,±20 delta,.005 exponential and2% snap constants; source PDF bytes are not written.

timingBoundaries: dispose clears every timer and pendingRAF
replacement document does not receive old raw/timers/anchor
nonCtrl does not prevent scrolling;Ctrl zero prevents default but starts no zoom work
checks.prototypeBuild: Vite build exit0, existing chunk size warning retained

retainedHarnessFailures.reason: Unit expected125% snap for122.14%, outside2% tolerance. Corrected independent expected math; product unchanged.
Prototype integration used App scroll CSS selector; changed test to actual fa-pdf-scroll; product unchanged.

separateBoundaries: No App pixel/parity claim. Current reference also defers canvas rendering while zooming; existing WillYou render policy is outside this T06 timing/teardown fix and was not changed.
This evidence does not close unrelated PDF scale/menu/layout/real rendering or lifecycle cases.

review.method: Independent read-only review; did not rerun tests.
review.result: No blocker within T06: raw separate from snap, distinct/restarted120/200ms deadlines, cumulative RAF anchor, document/session replacement and unmount cleanup; App/prototype effects do not recreate each zoom. Canvas rendering strategy remains outside this patch.
